title: Wasted runs are refused: empty test runs, stale docs at done, reused gate tests, routed fetches, CLI usage errors
goal: A tests.py run that collects nothing exits 2 naming its selector and no landing repeats a gone check; backlog.py done refuses an item whose commits leave a mapped kb/_self doc stale, before land; the sync gate reuses a passing test result for the same selection on the same tree; a PreToolUse hook denies WebFetch on a host whose routes-table row avoids it, naming the route; and kbusage.py errors reports the top usage errors of _tools scripts from this host's transcripts, with selfdoc.py section DOC listing headings and the three most frequent backlog.py and selfdoc.py errors fixed at the tool

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
